tasks.title: 1. Write the outline
tasks.instruction: Draft a short outline about how a CPU pipeline works. Return the outline only. No commands, uploads or purchases.

tasks.title: 2. Review the outline
tasks.instruction: Ask me for the completed outline, then check factual clarity. Return corrections for my review.

tasks.title: 3. Prepare the visual
tasks.instruction: Ask me for the approved outline. Propose a simple pipeline illustration. Wait for my permission before generating an image or consuming credits.

tasks.title: 4. Assemble the reel
tasks.instruction: Ask me for the approved outline and visual. Explain an editing sequence in Adobe. Wait for permission before changing project files.
